rule: Yoko's or her employer's documents never go into git or to an external service (Codex, Jev, web) without both her OK and her employer's. Until then they stay in the git-ignored materials/ folder of the main checkout and are read only locally.

materials.what: Goethe-Zertifikat B1 Wortliste (official PDF, free on goethe.de)
materials.unlocks: CEFR level of every entry checked against an official list instead of my judgement; a B1 standard target and its word coverage measurable

materials.what: Decision: Yoko's target – B1 standard (Goethe/telc B1) or a workplace target made of her units, with a date
materials.unlocks: P(pass) definition for the de-work track; unit order and pace

materials.what: Yoko's review of the units: which words she already knows, which ones her colleagues actually use (e.g. Ausschuss vs. Ausschussteile, du vs. Sie in meetings)
materials.unlocks: word lists matched to her plant's real vocabulary; known words dropped so the 5–10 per unit are all new

materials.what: Swiss German listening: SRF Meteo, SRF 'Puls' / 'Kassensturz', SRF 'Mini Beiz, dini Beiz', the dialect courses of 'Schwiizerdütsch' apps (e.g. Grüezi-Kurse) or a colleague recording short workplace sentences
materials.unlocks: Unit E (Swiss German heard at work) as listening items with audio clips
materials.who: Alex chooses and downloads only what the source licence allows; recordings by colleagues need their OK

materials.what: A powder-metallurgy glossary in German (e.g. Fachverband Pulvermetallurgie brochures, 'Pulvermetallurgie' Wikipedia, supplier datasheets from Höganäs or GKN, public)
materials.unlocks: Units A and F (mixing, pressing, sintering) with the terms the industry uses; correct technical plurals and collocations

materials.what: Her own work documents: a process instruction (Arbeitsanweisung), a test plan (Prüfplan), an 8D or deviation report, meeting minutes
materials.unlocks: items built from the exact sentences she must read and say; the strongest source for units B, D and G
materials.who: only with Yoko's OK and her employer's OK; anonymised copies; kept in materials/ (git-ignored), never sent to Codex or other external models

materials.what: Short voice notes of Yoko speaking German at work (optional)
materials.unlocks: goal 2 (more correct Standard German): her frequent errors become items, the way Anna's mistakes drive her N4 items
